desired_yaml:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: nginx-dev
  namespace: nginx-dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: nginx-dev
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
    app.kubernetes.io/version: 1.31.7
    helm.sh/chart: nginx-25.2.5
    environment: dev
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: nginx-dev
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 3
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 80
